definitions.explanation: A bird that lives primarily in and around the sea, such as gulls, albatrosses, and petrels. A general term for birds adapted to marine environments.

examples.japanese: {海鳥|うみどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: Seabirds are flying in the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海鳥|うみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繁殖地|はんしょくち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This island is known as a breeding ground for seabirds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{海鳥|うみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}いかけている→追いかける：16734_oikakeru⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Near the harbor, I could see a flock of seabirds chasing fish.

notes:
USAGE:
A straightforward compound of ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea) + ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧ (bird), with rendaku changing とり to どり. The word is also sometimes read as かいちょう in more scientific or formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海鳥|うみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧ (a flock of seabirds)
- {海鳥|うみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繁殖地|はんしょくち} (seabird breeding ground)
- {海鳥|うみどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧ (seabirds soar)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{野鳥|やちょう}→野鳥：14497_yachou⟧ (wild bird) is a broader term for any wild bird. {水鳥|みずどり} (waterbird, waterfowl) includes freshwater birds as well.
